column3: MT 38:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1; “to bring to remembrance” is rendered “for a memorial.” “Anger” and “wrath” are rendered “wrath” and “burning anger.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB's punctuation attaches “Because of my folly” to verse 6.
Close to the Hebrew; “I roar” is rendered “I groan,” and “the groaning of my heart” as “the agitation of my heart.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my friends and my companions” is rendered “My loved ones and my friends.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they have spoken destructions” is rendered “have threatened destruction.”
The Hebrew has “my enemies are alive”; NASB renders “vigorous,” and “falsehood” as “wrongfully.”
